bio: Located in the centre of Gmunden, the long-standing Zum Goldenen Hirschen dates back to the 17C. Now a tastefully designed boutique hotel, it is showcasing its interesting culinary side with this appealing restaurant. It serves a set menu that lends itself to sharing: Three courses comprising a total of 12 dishes demonstrate fine craftsmanship and the premium quality of the selected ingredients. The service is very friendly and attentive – the chef enjoys bringing out the dishes himself. Be sure to peruse the nicely curated wine list. There is also much to admire in the setting: A distinctive brick vaulted ceiling, gorgeous hardwood floors and a pleasingly understated yet chic modern style foster harmonious feel....
